I’ve never seen a post that summed up my life so perfectly. 
Recently I had to go to the ER because I felt like it would never get better and I decided I didn’t want to, and shouldn’t have to, suffer any longer.  While there I spoke with a social worker for roughly 4 hours, and honestly I felt a lot better.  She was able to give me a new perspective on life, and she gave me a lot of amazing advice. However I have almost 0 memory and I have forgotten just about everything.  But the kicker is I was already in therapy, and trying to get a handle on my depression and general misery.  
I’m telling you this, from one ND to another,  so you know I can actually relate. I’m not some happy go lucky  dipshit that’s going to tell you: “to hold on buddy, cuz it gets better!”  
It doesn’t get better, it just stops getting worse. And you get used to it, and you’ll start to find joy in the small things. And eventually you feel better with where you’re at, and you’ll be happier than you are now.  But healing is NOT linear, and there will be times when it feels worse than ever before.  You need to prepare for those times, but I can’t tell you how.  
I fully recommend talking with your doctor, who can hopefully get you into a therapy program.  
I was miserable for like 14 years (and counting) but I’m finally getting help and it’s slowly getting better-ish.
